sources.label: CLI-first Morphe patches developed for SBS On Demand
sources.author: Supperelias2 SBS
patch_list: Experimental: automatic intro and recap skipping
Experimental separate opt-in VOD intro and recap skipping, once per segment and media item.
Experimental: binge-watching preset
Adds an opt-in preset button for automatic intros/recaps, uninterrupted watching and a shorter next-episode delay. Individual switches remain available.
Experimental: bounded VOD buffer recovery
Experimental opt-in restart after 25 seconds of continuous direct-VOD buffering, with at most two attempts per media session. Live, ads, DRM and player errors are excluded.
Experimental: clean paused picture
Adds opt-in hiding of controls while paused, using the synchronized SBS visibility path. Off by default.
Experimental: controls timeout
Adds an opt-in controls timeout to Morphe settings. Normal three-second behavior is preserved by default.
Experimental: correct intro and recap seeking
Experimental provider-aware VOD skip correction. Enabled in Morphe settings by default.
Experimental: custom seek intervals
Experimental separate rewind and forward intervals for player and live controls, with matching PiP descriptions. Defaults to 15 seconds.
Experimental: customize subtitles
Adds optional subtitle size, bottom margin, and high-contrast styling to Morphe settings. Disabled at runtime by default; SBS mobile 6.4.0 only.
Experimental: external direct-stream player
Adds opt-in handoff of direct VOD to an installed video player. DRM content stays in SBS; session/format limitations can apply.
Experimental: local playback diagnostics
Adds an opt-in provider, resolution, bitrate and buffer overlay. Does not show stream URLs or account data.
Experimental: next episode countdown
Adds an opt-in next-episode delay preference. Original autoplay, cancel and watch-credits actions are retained.
Experimental: persistent VOD playback speed
Experimental saved playback speed for direct VOD. Opt-in; live and Google DAI remain at normal speed.
Experimental: reduce telemetry
Adds an off-by-default setting to suppress selected navigation, interaction and playback analytics events. SDK initialization remains enabled.
Experimental: remember video quality
Adds optional remembered bitrate, automatic, and highest-supported quality modes to Morphe settings. Disabled at runtime by default; SBS mobile 6.4.0 only.
Experimental: uninterrupted watching
Adds an opt-in switch to stop inactivity prompts and their player exit. Long-pause stream refresh is preserved.
Morphe settings
Adds Morphe settings above App Settings and Language in the account menu.
Prefer direct live stream
Removes extra video ads from live TV by selecting the direct stream when available. Ads in the broadcast remain.
Prefer direct VOD stream
Removes pre-roll and mid-roll video ads by selecting SBS's direct VOD stream when available.
SBS playback compatibility check
Verifies the playback methods required by the VOD and live ad-removal patches.
